name: vl-convert
role: Vega and Vega-Lite static export runtime
notes: 2026-11-01: Dependency-free Vega and Vega-Lite rendering to SVG, PNG and PDF from Python or CLI.
2026-11-15: 2.0.0-rc7 is a prerelease; stable release is 1.9.0. v2 API and behavior may change before stable release.
summary: Rust-based converter available as a library, CLI/server and Python package. It compiles Vega-Lite or Vega specifications and exports SVG, PNG, JPEG, PDF, HTML and scenegraphs without requiring a browser or Node.js. It embeds the official Vega JavaScript libraries and runs them in V8; local and remote resource access is configurable and relevant when processing external specs.
use_when: Render Vega-Lite specifications to SVG, PNG or PDF in a scripted pipeline
Use when a browser or Node runtime should not be required for chart export
avoid_when: Use Vega or Vega-Lite directly when interactive browser output is the deliverable
Use Matplotlib or Altair when authoring and statistical plotting ergonomics matter more than Vega interchange

install.macos: python3 -m pip install vl-convert-python (or cargo install vl-convert --locked)

assessment.rationale: Official releases show active v2 development through 2.0.0-rc7 (2026-09-14); stable release listed is 1.9.0. BSD-3-Clause. Its embedded Vega/Vega-Lite runtime offers reproducible server-side export without browser/Node dependencies.
